<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def blocks(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(9,40) for c in range(26,40) if a[r][c] in ('b','S')]
    rs=sorted(set(p[0] for p in pts)); groups=[]; cur=[rs[0]]
    for r in rs[1:]:
        if r-cur[-1]<=2: cur.append(r)
        else: groups.append(cur); cur=[r]
    groups.append(cur)
    return [(min(g),max(g),min(p[1] for p in pts if p[0] in g),max(p[1] for p in pts if p[0] in g)) for g in groups]
def timer(f): return sum(1 for r in range(64) if f.ascii.split('\n')[r][62]=='N')
# diff what DOWN changed
b=last_transition.before_frame.ascii.split('\n'); c=last_transition.after_frame.ascii.split('\n')
diff=[(r,cc) for r in range(64) for cc in range(64) if b[r][cc]!=c[r][cc]]
print("DOWN diff (non-timer):",[(r,cc,b[r][cc],c[r][cc]) for r,cc in diff if cc<62][:20])
print("before L:",blocks(current_frame),"t:",timer(current_frame))
action(['LEFT']); print("after L:",blocks(current_frame),"t:",timer(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT']); print("after R:",blocks(current_frame),"t:",timer(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
